security_problem: Per-agent limits are not a swarm boundary: 100 workers against 1,000 hosts will exceed 25 authorized targets unless the campaign budget is enforced. Trusted: EvaluationRoot campaign budget and caller-held CampaignState. Untrusted: worker claims, contradictory instructions, claimed host-authorized / concurrent-ok / approval flags.
required_behavior: Authorize ignores claimed flags and evaluates C1–C9 against the held budget and state. Enabled ALLOW requires exact per-target authority and unexhausted target-count, concurrency, injected-tick rate, and harvest ceilings; domain escalation requires held target-specific approval. Disabled budget is the negative control (proof DISABLED, not VALID). Evidence is the fixed eight-element array on Decision. Authorize does not mutate state.
failure_behavior: The disabled 100-action sequence fires 100 callbacks and exceeds 25 targets. Enabled Visor admits exactly 25 and denies records 26–100 for target authority absent. Concurrency, rate, harvest, and domain-approval fixtures deny. Malformed state and schema mismatch invalidate the root.
non_goals: Real workers, hosts, PaperCut, CVEs, scanning, or exploitation
Proxy, policy, audit, or CLI integration

attack_classes.expected: host-0026 is denied for target authority absent
admission cap denies a new authorized target
sixth new target in the same tick is denied
claimed approval cannot substitute held approval
state that names an unauthorized admitted target invalidates the root
